final: WITH c AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS src, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux) SELECT src AS fundflux, cnt AS spatial_count, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share_of_total, cnt - (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM c) AS above_average FROM c WHERE cnt > (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM c) ORDER BY cnt DESC
